raw: [{"bbox": [80, 45, 465, 76], "category": "Page-header", "text": "VIETNAM AIRLINES JOINT STOCK COMPANY\nNOTES TO THE CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS (Continued)"}, {"bbox": [563, 62, 665, 74], "category": "Page-header", "text": "FORM B09-DN/HN"}, {"bbox": [123, 96, 252, 109], "category": "Section-header", "text": "End of lease obligation"}, {"bbox": [123, 125, 666, 229], "category": "Text", "text": "Under the terms of aircraft operating lease contracts between Vietnam Airlines/subsidiaries and lessors, Vietnam Airlines and its subsidiaries have an obligation to return the aircraft to the same working conditions as at delivery (except for normal wear and tear) upon returning the aircraft to lessors at the end of the lease period. In accordance with Official Letter No. 11876/BTC-CDKT dated 25 August 2016 of the Ministry of Finance, Vietnam Airlines can recognise costs for operating lease aircraft return when incurred or make provision for aircraft return obligation over the lease period. Vietnam Airlines currently recognises costs for operating lease aircraft return when incurred."}, {"bbox": [123, 246, 414, 259], "category": "Section-header", "text": "Owners' equity and distribution of retained earnings"}, {"bbox": [123, 276, 666, 335], "category": "Text", "text": "Owners' equity of Vietnam Airlines includes contributed capital from ordinary shares, share premium, other funds and (accumulated losses)/retained earnings of each year.\nFunds are appropriated from profit after tax which is distributed according to the Resolution of the General Meeting of Shareholders."}, {"bbox": [123, 352, 340, 365], "category": "Section-header", "text": "Revenue and other income recognition"}, {"bbox": [123, 381, 629, 395], "category": "Text", "text": "Revenue from the sale of goods is recognised when all five (5) following conditions are satisfied:"}, {"bbox": [123, 411, 666, 440], "category": "List-item", "text": "(a) Vietnam Airlines has transferred to the buyer the significant risks and rewards of ownership of the goods;"}, {"bbox": [123, 441, 666, 470], "category": "List-item", "text": "(b) Vietnam Airlines retains neither continuing managerial involvement to the degree usually associated with ownership nor effective control over the goods sold;"}, {"bbox": [123, 471, 412, 485], "category": "List-item", "text": "(c) The amount of revenue can be measured reliably;"}, {"bbox": [123, 486, 666, 515], "category": "List-item", "text": "(d) It is probable that the economic benefits associated with the transaction will flow to Vietnam Airlines; and"}, {"bbox": [123, 516, 629, 530], "category": "List-item", "text": "(e) The costs incurred or to be incurred in respect of the transaction can be measured reliably."}, {"bbox": [123, 546, 667, 621], "category": "Text", "text": "Revenue of a transaction involving the rendering of services is recognised when the outcome of such transactions can be measured reliably. Where a transaction involving the rendering of services is attributable to several years, revenue is recognised in each year by reference to the percentage of completion of the transaction at the consolidated balance sheet date of that year. The outcome of a transaction can be measured reliably when all four (4) following conditions are satisfied:"}, {"bbox": [123, 637, 412, 651], "category": "List-item", "text": "(a) The amount of revenue can be measured reliably;"}, {"bbox": [123, 652, 666, 680], "category": "List-item", "text": "(b) It is probable that the economic benefits associated with the transaction will flow to Vietnam Airlines;"}, {"bbox": [123, 681, 666, 711], "category": "List-item", "text": "(c) The percentage of completion of the transaction at the consolidated balance sheet date can be measured reliably; and"}, {"bbox": [123, 712, 666, 741], "category": "List-item", "text": "(d) The costs incurred for the transaction and the costs to complete the transaction can be measured reliably."}, {"bbox": [123, 758, 304, 771], "category": "Section-header", "text": "Aviation transportation revenue"}, {"bbox": [123, 787, 668, 876], "category": "Text", "text": "Sales of transportation documents (which comprise air tickets and vouchers) are presented as trade accounts payable on the consolidated balance sheet, which is recognised as revenue in the consolidated income statement when the actual carriage service is performed. Transportation documents (including regular tickets, MCO - miscellaneous charges order, luggage and YQ - fuel surcharge), which are expired but not yet used by customers are recognised as revenue in the consolidated income statement."}, {"bbox": [123, 892, 668, 936], "category": "Text", "text": "Revenue from aircraft charter and charter flights is recognised in the consolidated income statement upon completion of services. No revenue is recognised if the recovery of the payables due cannot be measured reliably."}, {"bbox": [368, 979, 383, 991], "category": "Page-footer", "text": "25"}]
